verdict: BNY grew revenue 12% to $5.7B on higher fees and interest income, earning $1.6B for common shareholders while safeguarding $63.4 trillion of client assets.

kpis.label: Revenue growth
kpis.note: Revenue was $5.7B, vs $5.1B a year ago

kpis.label: Assets under custody
kpis.note: +10% YoY — assets BNY safeguards for clients

segments.name: Net interest income
segments.note: Interest earned on loans and securities, minus interest paid on deposits and borrowings — up 15% as securities were reinvested at higher yields and the balance sheet grew, partly offset by thinner deposit margins.

segments.name: Noninterest revenue
segments.note: Fees and other non-interest income: $4,078M of fee revenue (asset servicing, issuer services, clearance, wealth and payments fees, up 12%) plus $175M of investment and other revenue.

opex.name: Staff
opex.note: Pay and benefits — BNY's biggest cost, up 3% YoY.

opex.name: Software & equipment
opex.note: Technology, software and equipment — up 9% as BNY invests in its platforms.

opex.name: Professional & other purchased services
opex.note: Outside professional and purchased services ($474M) plus other expenses ($136M).

opex.name: Sub-custodian, occupancy & other
opex.note: Sub-custodian and clearing costs ($168M), offices ($141M), distribution and servicing ($78M), business development ($58M), bank assessments ($27M) and intangible amortization ($9M).

footerNote: For a bank, the provision for credit losses ($1M this quarter) plays the role of cost of revenue. Net income was $1,687M in total; $1,608M of it was applicable to common shareholders after preferred dividends. BNY calls its profit before tax 'income before taxes' of $2,186M — shown here as operating profit, with no separate other-income line.
oneTimers: Notable items were small this quarter: $23M of severance expense, partly offset by a $1M litigation-reserve release — a net $22M pre-tax drag. Excluding them, adjusted EPS was $2.37 vs $2.34 GAAP.

takeaways.title: Fees did the heavy lifting
takeaways.text: Fee revenue rose 12% to $4,078M on new business, higher client activity and higher market values. Assets under custody rose 10% to $63.4 trillion and assets under management 2% to $2.2 trillion.

takeaways.title: Interest income kept climbing
takeaways.text: Net interest income rose 15% to $1,423M as maturing securities were reinvested at higher yields and loans grew 19% on average — even though deposit margins narrowed.

takeaways.title: Most profit went back to shareholders
takeaways.text: BNY returned $1.4B in the quarter — $937M of share buybacks plus $436M of dividends — while keeping a 38.5% pre-tax margin and a 10.9% CET1 capital ratio.
